paper.title_en: A Unified Multi-Band Secular Framework for the Hierarchical Triple PSR J0435+3233 System
paper.abstract_en: The millisecond pulsar PSR J0435+3233, discovered by FAST, exhibits an unusually large apparent spin-down rate, potentially reflecting line-of-sight acceleration from a distant companion. Recent investigations reveal a hierarchical triple consisting of an inner pulsar-helium white dwarf binary with an orbital period of ~8 days, orbited by a G-type subgiant tertiary on an eccentric ~74 yr orbit. The current timing description admits two distinct geometrical solutions. We develop a singly averaged (SA) formulation that averages over the inner orbit while retaining the instantaneous phase of the eccentric outer orbit, thereby capturing the time-dependent quadrupolar perturbations induced by the tertiary. We show how this physical three-body description can be incorporated naturally into pulsar-timing analyses and use it to forward-propagate the two currently viable configurations, Tv1 and Tv2, to forecast when their timing signatures become distinguishable with FAST. The SA evolution predicts that the two configurations will become distinguishable in the coming years, with the effective projected semi-major axis, $x_{1,\mathrm{eff}}$, providing the earliest discriminating observable. We further extend the framework to predict the tertiary's spectroscopic radial-velocity and astrometric evolution, linking FAST timing with LAMOST time-domain spectroscopy and Gaia astrometry. This multi-band framework has the potential to establish PSR J0435+3233 as an exceptionally well-constrained laboratory for three-body dynamics, compact-binary and stellar evolution, and gravitational physics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文针对FAST发现的毫秒脉冲星PSR J0435+3233层级三体系统，提出了单平均（SA）框架，将内轨平均并保留偏心外轨的瞬时相位，以刻画第三体引起的时间依赖四极扰动；并将其自然嵌入脉冲星计时分析，前向传播两个可行构型Tv1/Tv2，预测其计时特征何时可被区分，且以x1,eff作为最早判别观测量，同时扩展到光谱径向速度与天体测量演化，衔接FAST计时、LAMOST时域光谱与Gaia天体测量。该工作对脉冲星计时分析方法与多波段联合约束有直接贡献，理论构造明确、可检验预言具体，且属于30天内的新论文，零引用为中性。
decision.title_zh: 用于层级三体系统PSR J0435+3233的统一多波段长期框架
decision.abstract_zh: FAST发现的毫秒脉冲星PSR J0435+3233表现出异常大的表观自转减慢率，这可能反映了来自远距伴星的视线方向加速度。近期研究揭示了一个层级三体系统，其内层是一个脉冲星-氦白矮星双星，轨道周期约为8天，外层由一个G型亚巨星第三体在偏心的约74年轨道上绕行。当前的计时描述允许两个不同的几何解。我们发展了一种单平均（SA）表述，它平均掉内层轨道，同时保留偏心外层轨道的瞬时相位，从而捕捉由第三体引起的时间依赖四极扰动。我们展示了如何将这种物理三体描述自然地纳入脉冲星计时分析，并用它前向传播两个当前可行的构型Tv1和Tv2，以预测它们的计时特征何时能用FAST区分。SA演化预测，这两个构型将在未来几年内变得可区分，其中有效投影半长轴$x_{1,\mathrm{eff}}$提供了最早的判别观测量。我们进一步扩展该框架，以预测第三体的光谱径向速度和天体测量演化，从而将FAST计时与LAMOST时域光谱和Gaia天体测量联系起来。这一多波段框架有潜力将PSR J0435+3233确立为三体动力学、致密双星与恒星演化以及引力物理的一个约束得异常良好的实验室。
